title: Device ID SSOT + permanent Admin revoke
root_cause: subscriptionFalseExpiredRepair treated status≠active + future expires_at as false-expired and set status=active — reactivating admin-revoked rows
isAdminRevokedOrderBlocked only blocked the exact revoked order_id; pre-revoke pending SonicPesa orders completing later called upsertDeviceSubscriptionActive and cleared admin_revoked_*
SQL active_now ignored admin_revoked_at; verify remaining_days could stay non-zero for revoked rows; Admin mapSubscriptionRow exposed remaining ms even when revoked
Inactive verify fast-path set txnSummary=null so App lacked canonical amount/plan_duration while Admin still showed plan price
fixes: Fail-closed revoke gate: block same order, any order created_at ≤ admin_revoked_at, and unknown created_at
False-expired repair excludes status=revoked and admin_revoked_at IS NOT NULL
active_now and remaining_* SQL require admin_revoked_at IS NULL
rowToPublicStatus forceZero remaining when !active; Admin mapSubscriptionRow remaining_days=0 when revoked
Inactive verify still loads txn summary for canonical Account fields
Existing upsert/finalize paths pass order created_at into revoke gate; deviceSubscriptionRelay + cache invalidate on revoke unchanged

safety.midnight_policy: applies only to new purchases after natural expiry; existing expiries preserved

admin_lookup.note: status matched App but remaining inflated; canonical plan fields incomplete on verify

api_verification.GET /api/users/lookup?q=<deviceId>: Cache-Control no-store; live operational row matches verify
api_verification.POST /api/subscription/verify: active=false status=revoked remaining_days=0 with canonical amount/duration

sse_verification.notifyAdminSubscriptionRevoked: invalidates access cache + deviceSubscriptionBus update + liveSync subscription_revoked
sse_verification.subscription-stream: emits device_subscription + writeAdminRevokedSseEvents (subscription_revoked, subscription_wake, device_subscription_updated) with suppress_expiry_popup
